potential_clients.summary: Sabri Amara's Medicare insurance business operates in Illinois and Indiana, and two comprehensive strategy calls have focused on setting up marketing campaigns and technical systems for an October 15th launch. The team is working through certification and compliance requirements including active G2 Risk certification for Indiana with Illinois pending, planning a HIPAA add-on at $300 to $500 monthly for data safety, and addressing Google approval needs.
